summary: The note describes "The Ballad of Jed Clampett," the theme song for the TV show and movie The Beverly Hillbillies. It explains that the song provided the series' back story. It credits Paul Henning as writer and composer, Jerry Scoggins as the original vocalist with bluegrass musicians Lester Flatt and Earl Scruggs, and notes that Flatt sang lead when the theme was released as a single.
one_line: The Ballad of Jed Clampett is the bluegrass theme song for The Beverly Hillbillies, written by Paul Henning and sung by Jerry Scoggins.
key_facts: The Ballad of Jed Clampett was the theme song for The Beverly Hillbillies TV show and movie.
The theme song provided the back story for The Beverly Hillbillies series.
Paul Henning written and composed The Ballad of Jed Clampett.
Jerry Scoggins sang The Ballad of Jed Clampett.
Jerry Scoggins was accompanied by bluegrass musicians Lester Flatt and Earl Scruggs.
When the theme was released as a single, Lester Flatt sang lead vocals instead of Jerry Scoggins.
The Ballad of Jed Clampett is a bluegrass-style theme song.
The note's source is listed as Wikipedia.
